title: Read a company’s financial snapshot
prompt: Show Apple’s latest available annual and quarterly revenue, net income, cash, debt and operating cash flow. Keep the actual period for each figure and flag missing data.
intro: Apple’s revenue and net income are available. Cash and debt are missing from this provider response.

blocks.text: Annual period: 29 Sep 2024–27 Sep 2025. Quarterly period: 29 Mar–27 Jun 2026. The saved SEC company facts matched these figures.
Operating cash flow has a different quarterly period: Q1 FY2026. It must not be presented as Q3.

limits: Corrected replay of saved Atlas data. “Latest” refers to the saved payload. Missing cash and debt were not guessed or replaced with liabilities.
